items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1961-05-11
items.q: How about Tommy Howell? Did you know Tommy Howell? No, I didn't.

ctx.x: That was in the days of Troy Floyd. Yeah. 26, 27 and 28. That's right. Then of course you had another great trumpet player in the Southwest.
How about Tommy Howell? Did you know Tommy Howell? No, I didn't. Did you ever hear of a trombone player by the name of Sonny Clapp?
